auditor: College Hub Security Architecture & QA Team

checks.name: OWASP Top 10 Injection & SQL Security
checks.details: All queries use Drizzle ORM parameterization with PostgreSQL RLS set_config session isolation.

checks.name: Authentication & Identity Kernel
checks.details: Argon2id password hashing, mandatory EDU domain validation, multi-factor OTP verification.

checks.name: Cryptographic Audit Trail Integrity
checks.details: SHA-256 hash chaining enabled for administrative log entries; IPv4/IPv6 address masking enforced.

checks.name: Kubernetes Pod Security Standards (PSS)
checks.details: Containers run as non-root (UID 10001), drop ALL Linux capabilities, enforce read-only root filesystems.

checks.name: Zero-Trust Network Policies
checks.details: Strict ingress/egress network policies isolate tenant namespaces, PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO workloads.

checks.name: Dependency & Supply Chain Security
checks.details: CycloneDX SBOM generated; zero critical/high CVEs identified across pnpm workspace packages.

checks.name: Secret & Credential Management
checks.details: No hardcoded credentials; Kubernetes secrets injected via environment variables; placeholder protection verified.

checks.name: Rate Limiting & Anti-DDoS Defenses
checks.details: Fastify rate limiters and Redis token bucket algorithms active on public API endpoints.
